ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central and lower regions, 40% low-intensity black pixels localized on the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white central region spanning both lobes; thick, irregular low-intensity black banding along the trailing edge; a cluster of distinct circular black focal spots on the far-left outer margin; solid black pigmentation at the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 100 degrees; significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary; alternating peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from shallow undulations to sharp incisions, particularly on the inner left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the lower leading edges; the trailing edges follow an irregular convex-to-linear sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a cluster containing 7-8 roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters on the white background of the far left tip; additional single circular marks observed on the lower left and upper right white regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) intersecting the black pigmentation on the inner right lobe and center-left area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks crossing dark pigmentation zones; localized circular scarring consistent with barnacle attachment points on the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'constellation' pattern formed by the circular spots on the far left margin of the fluke.
